Subject: CS Handshake: Implementation Sprints & Owner Calendar

Hi Alice —

Great talking yesterday. Per our call, I put together a first-pass implementation schedule and owner matrix so we can agree on sprint milestones and handoff points before Connor kicks off the infra prep. Key asks below; draft MAP attached.

High-level plan (draft):
- Week 1 (May 10–14): Kickoff & discovery (owners: Aurora PM — Alice; Redwood CS — Marissa)
- Week 2–3 (May 17–28): Integration sprints (owners: Connor + Aurora Eng lead)
- Week 4 (May 31–Jun 4): Security review & compliance evidence delivery (owners: Monica + Aurora security)
- Week 5 (Jun 7–11): Pilot verification & go/no-go decision (owners: Marissa + Alice)

Open items / asks:
1) Please confirm Aurora owners for integration and security contacts.
2) Can the Aurora networking team review the attached network requirements by May 12?
3) We propose a standing 30-min sync each Monday at 10am PT — ok?

Attachments:
- AUR_onboarding_MAP_v1.2.xlsx (spreadsheet): milestone table, RACI, dates
- aurora_network_requirements.pdf (doc): firewall / VPC / peering checklist

If you confirm owners and the proposed cadence, we’ll lock dates and send calendar invites.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this underway.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
